title: In vitro Antibiofilm Activity-directed In silico Identification of Natural Products Targeting Bacterial Biofilm Regulators SarA and LasR.
authors: Shilpi, Jamil A; Sarker, Dipto Kumer; Seidel, Veronique; Ali, Mohammad Tuhin; Uddin, Shaikh Jamal; Basak, Ananya; Chakraborty, Shaown; Khairuzzaman, M; Nahar, Akhlak Un; Salam, Fayad Bin Abdus
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究天然产物与细菌转录调控蛋白SarA/LasR的结合，虽涉及TF-DNA相关蛋白但未聚焦DNA互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Antibiofilm agents serve as an essential tool in the fight against antibiotic resistance, and natural products provide a promising source for potential drug leads. OBJECTIVE: This study investigates the activity of twenty Bangladeshi medicinal plants against Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilms and predicts the interactions of selected phytochemicals from five of the best performing plants with the active sites of transcriptional regulatory proteins SarA of S. aureus and LasR of P. aeruginosa. METHODS: The plant extracts were tested by microtiter plate-based assay against S. aureus and P. aeruginosa biofilms. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation (MD) were conducted using PyRx and GROMACS, respectively. RESULTS: The best activity was identified for Cassia fistula and Ananas comosus, showing >/= 75% inhibition of biofilm formation. ent-Epicatechin-(4alpha-->8)-epiafzelechin (EEE) of C. fistula, cyanidin-3,3',5-tri-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside (CTG) of A. comosus, and 7-O-(4-hydroxy-Ecinnamoyl)- spinoside of A. spinosus showed the best predictive binding affinity (-7.6, -7.6 and - 7.7 kcal/mol, respectively) for SarA. EEE was the only ligand to exhibit a stable ligand-protein complex with SarA in the MD simulation of 200 ns (binding energy of MMPBSA analysis - 39.899 kJ/mol). Chrysophanol, epicatechin and physcion, of C. fistula (-10.5, -10.5, and -11.0 kcal/mol, respectively) and auraptene of F. limonia (-10.8 kcal/mol) showed the best predictive binding affinity for LasR. Epicatechin showed the most stable ligand-protein complex with LasR (binding energy of MMPBSA analysis -63.717 kJ/mol). CONCLUSION: Epicatechin and its derivative EEE could be used as scaffolds for the development of new antibiofilm agents against P. aeruginosa and S. aureus, respectively.
abstract_zh: 背景：抗生物膜剂是对抗抗生素耐药性的重要工具，天然产物为潜在药物先导物提供了有前景的来源。目的：本研究调查了二十种孟加拉国药用植物对金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）和铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）生物膜的活性，并预测了来自五种表现最佳植物中选定的植物化学物质与金黄色葡萄球菌SarA和铜绿假单胞菌LasR转录调控蛋白活性位点的相互作用。方法：通过基于微量滴定板的测定法测试植物提取物对金黄色葡萄球菌和铜绿假单胞菌生物膜的活性。分子对接和分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation, MD）分别使用PyRx和GROMACS进行。结果：最佳活性见于决明子（Cassia fistula）和菠萝（Ananas comosus），对生物膜形成的抑制率≥75%。决明子的ent-表儿茶素-(4α→8)-表阿夫儿茶素（EEE）、菠萝的花青素-3,3',5-三-O-β-D-吡喃葡萄糖苷（CTG）以及刺苋（A. spinosus）的7-O-(4-羟基-E-肉桂酰基)-刺苋苷对SarA显示出最佳预测结合亲和力（分别为-7.6、-7.6和-7.7 kcal/mol）。在200 ns的MD模拟中，EEE是唯一与SarA形成稳定配体-蛋白质复合物的配体（MMPBSA分析结合能为-39.899 kJ/mol）。决明子的大黄酚、表儿茶素和大黄素甲醚（分别为-10.5、-10.5和-11.0 kcal/mol）以及柠檬（F. limonia）的橙皮油素（-10.8 kcal/mol）对LasR显示出最佳预测结合亲和力。表儿茶素与LasR形成最稳定的配体-蛋白质复合物（MMPBSA分析结合能为-63.717 kJ/mol）。结论：表儿茶素及其衍生物EEE可分别作为开发针对铜绿假单胞菌和金黄色葡萄球菌的新型抗生物膜剂的支架。
